title: Confirmed Attendance and the No-Show Fee on In-Person Appointments
content:
**Clause.** Where the patient confirmed attendance at an In-Person Appointments visit and then missed it, a sum is added to the no-show fee the missed visit carries:

(a) where the patient confirmed the missed visit **2 days or fewer** before its scheduled date, **25.00** dollars are added;

(b) where the patient confirmed it **more than 2 days** before its scheduled date, **15.00** dollars are added;

(c) where the patient never confirmed it, nothing is added.

The confirmation date is the date on the appointment record on which the patient confirmed attendance in answer to a reminder; the days are counted from that date to the scheduled date.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, scheduled date 2026-11-12).**

| Confirmed on | Days before the scheduled date | Paragraph | Added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-10 | 2 | (a) | 25.00 dollars |
| 2026-11-12 | 0 | (a) | 25.00 dollars |
| 2026-11-09 | 3 | (b) | 15.00 dollars |
| never | not applicable | (c) | nothing |
